rounds.text: At a modest market capitalisation of ₹ 88.2 Cr., Mysore Paper Mills Ltd is significantly under-appreciated given its notable capacity for top-line expansion and operational turnaround [E1]. The business demonstrates structural growth potential, evidenced by a 5-year compounded sales growth rate of 15% that outpaces the sector median sales growth of 11.9% [E3, E30]. Recent fundamental catalysts confirm this momentum, highlighted by a screen reason of sales jumping 40% year-over-year alongside strong overall sales growth signals [E23, E24]. Furthermore, profitability mechanics are sharply rebounding at the margin level, shown by a quarterly operating margin of 63% in June 2026—a substantial 16 percentage point expansion compared to 47% in the year-ago quarter [E11]. Conceded: trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth has contracted by 36% alongside a 10% decline in compounded profit growth and a compression of operating margins from 76% to 40% [E5, E8, E10].
